mapper.sql: b.id, b.equipment_id, b.start_time, b.end_time, b.booking_start_time, b.booking_end_time, b.total_quota, b.remaining_quota, b.status, b.create_time, b.update_time, e.name AS equipment_name, e.laboratory_id, l.name AS laboratory_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_reservation_batch b LEFT JOIN tb_equipment e ON b.equipment_id = e.id LEFT JOIN tb_laboratory l ON e.laboratory_id = l.id WHERE b.id = #{id}
